data.title: Build a rotating collectible with inspection
data.summary: One collectible mesh, an inspection camera and a 0.3 m interaction radius. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: GLTFLoader loads glTF assets; compressed features can require configured decoders.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender → Godot or Unity environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: One collectible mesh, an inspection camera and a 0.3 m interaction radius.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent pickup inspection workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: One collectible mesh, an inspection camera and a 0.3 m interaction radius. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Export the object with a centered inspection pivot and a separate collision proxy
Implement a pickup state that hides the world object and shows its inspection instance
Rotate the inspection instance with bounded input and restore focus on close

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.

data.prompt: Help me build a rotating collectible with inspection in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: One collectible mesh, an inspection camera and a 0.3 m interaction radius. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Closing returns keyboard control to the player; The item cannot be picked up twice or duplicated by repeated input. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
